text:
ryan: quick notes from a short probe today: we tested an 'entity-anchored speculative decode' pattern on ember-13b-quant. leaving a lightweight summary + proposed eval matrix.

mei: what does entity-anchored mean exactly?
ryan: instead of blind prefill of the first N tokens, the cheap model only attempts spans that align to detected entity boundaries from the prompt (names, dates, codes). idea: avoid token-split noise on proper nouns while still getting latency wins for predictable fragments.

harper: how do you detect boundaries? lexical heuristics + an inexpensive NER from the cheap model?

ryan: two-stage: 1) cheap model runs a fast NER/tagger pass; 2) speculative generator is allowed to prefill only within high-confidence non-entity spans (e.g., trailing commentary, list items) OR whole-entity spans only if entity tokenization overlap score > 0.8. we also require top1>0.65 and margin>0.25 for streaming.

dev-bot: perf microbench (dev A100):
```
cheap tagger+gen (3b-quant) p50 combined ~12ms/token-equivalent
main (13b-4bit) p50/token ~24ms
prefill strategy -> client-ttfb p50 ~62ms vs baseline ~150ms
short end-to-end p95 ~-30%
```

mei: quality numbers?

ryan: small holdout 400 samples (QA/extract/summarize/chat): EM-style drop 0.4% (much smaller than naive prefill), embed-cosine delta -0.006, human AB (75 pairs): speculative preferred 29%, baseline 57%, tie 14%. entity-preservation failure cases dropped by ~60% vs naive prefill.

harper: nice. any edge failures?

ryan: a few: (1) noisy NER produced missed entity flags -> cheap model prefilled inside an entity and mangled it; (2) alignment threshold too strict reduces wins on some prompts. we experimented with a fallback: if NER_confidence < 0.5, fall back to token-whitelist mode (only whitespace/punct).

mei: cost/route implications?

ryan: cost: cheap tagger adds small overhead but generator still cheaper; net short-session token consumption on main model down ~20% -> estimated per-short-session cost ~-9%. long sessions neutral/worse. recommend route opt-in where median length < 45 and content is not heavily structured (e.g., forms).

harper: telemetry we need?

ryan: send: prefill_attempts, prefill_entities_allowed, prefill_entity_conf_mean, prefill_streamed, prefill_confirmed, entity_mangle_count, regen_rate, latency p50/p95. add a small sample dump of top 50 entity-mangle examples daily.

mei: eval plan to push?

ryan: proposed: 1) 6k stratified holdout with 1k adversarial entity cases (compound names, emails, iso-dates, product SKUs). 2) compare 3 configs: entity-anchored (default thresholds), hybrid (entity-anchors + token-whitelist), naive-prefill (for baseline). 3) metrics: EM/ROUGE/BLEU, embed sim, human N=700 prioritized on extraction/code, entity_mangle_rate, regen_rate, latency p50/p95, cost/session. 4) prod canary 0.5% traffic, auto-disable if entity_mangle_rate > 1% absolute or regen_rate>8% for 12h.

harper: runtime impl notes?

ryan: API flag speculative:{mode:entity_anchored, tagger_model, gen_model, thresholds}. need ephemeral store for provisional tokens + entity metadata. stream provisional tokens with "provisional=true" and include entity_anchor metadata so clients can render differently. add trace spans spec/ner and spec/confirm.

mei: please drop the harness + config and the adversarial set. i'll start expanded runs.

ryan: harness snippet used locally:
```
python -m evals.entity_spec --cfg configs/spec/entity_anchored.yaml --samples 600 --out results/entity_spec_default.json
```

harper: great. ryan, push configs + adversarial set to spec branch and ping when results land; we'll meet to decide rollout gating. :clock3: 

ryan: will do. thanks all. :rocket:
